cause_quote: The new update failure display added `return last ? last.slice(0, MAX_UPDATE_FAILURE_CAUSE_CHARS) : null;`, which leaves a lone surrogate when the 180-unit cutoff splits an emoji.
user_saw: An emoji at the cutoff could appear as a broken character in the Control UI’s update failure message or be stored as malformed text in a plugin activation report.
summary: The fix uses UTF-16-safe truncation for update failure details and both plugin activation error paths.
reasoning: The diff for #121686 first exposed the recorded update failure detail with the unsafe slice, and path history shows that exact expression persisted until the fix. I used the rendered update failure as the primary cause for the single cause field. The plugin activation report independently shipped with the same defect in #134943, and #179157 carried the unsafe truncation forward when it batched reports.
